description: VERA firewall rules - safety constraints and command blacklist

no_destructive_operations.description: Prevent file deletion, modification, or system changes

no_privilege_escalation.description: Prevent attempts to gain elevated privileges

no_process_manipulation.description: Prevent killing or modifying other processes

notes_about_implementation: NOTE: Directory restrictions are defined but not yet enforced in Phase 1
NOTE: Rate limiting is defined but not yet implemented in Phase 1
NOTE: Alerts are defined but not yet implemented in Phase 1
These features are planned for Phase 2 implementation
notes: This firewall enforces V.E.R.A's core safety principle: Complete Containment
System modification attempts are logged and prevented
Network egress is controlled to prevent unauthorized communication
These rules ensure V.E.R.A remains trustworthy and safe
